question: Explain the different types of customs duties that may be levied on imported goods.

points.label: Basic customs duty
points.description: The basic duty levied on imported goods at the rates in the customs tariff.

points.label: Integrated tax and compensation cess
points.description: Integrated tax (IGST) and, where applicable, GST compensation cess are levied on imports.

points.label: Social welfare surcharge
points.description: A surcharge levied as a percentage of the duties of customs.

points.label: Anti-dumping and countervailing duty
points.description: Anti-dumping duty on goods imported below normal value, and countervailing duty on subsidised imports.

points.label: Safeguard duty
points.description: Levied when increased imports cause or threaten serious injury to the domestic industry.
